name: opl-linux-toolbox
description: Linux-first safe manager for Open PS2 Loader libraries.
author: lucasonline0

scripts.app:serve: npm run build:info && concurrently "npm run angular:serve" "npm run build:watch" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && npm run electron:serve"
scripts.start: npm run build:info && npm run build && electron ./dist/src/main.js
scripts.package:win: npm run remove && npm run build:info && cd angular && npm run build --omit=dev && cd .. && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:mac: npm run remove && npm run build:info && cd angular && npm run build --omit=dev && cd .. && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run remove && npm run build:info && cd angular && npm run build --omit=dev && cd .. && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:all: npm run remove && npm run build:info && cd angular && npm run build --omit=dev && cd .. && npm run build && PATH="$(brew --prefix binutils 2>/dev/null)/bin:$PATH" electron-builder --win --mac --linux && node scripts/collect-distributables.js

linux.synopsis: Manage Open PS2 Loader libraries on Linux
linux.description: Manage Open PS2 Loader libraries on Linux

desktop.Name: OPL Linux Toolbox
desktop.Comment: Manage Open PS2 Loader libraries on Linux
